protocol.title: Isolated disjoint-window OOS replication (BTC-only) of the suggestive EVAL-65 options order-flow toxicity -> forward realized-vol slice (tox/imbalance, bar60, horizon 72), wrapper-free Spearman rank IC

protocol.supersedes: nothing — replication check for the only suggestive EVAL-65 slice on BTC; non-replication or BLOCKED is a valid sealed result

Because the free Deribit perp 1m endpoint returns at most 5001 candles (300000 s), the capture must also span >=300000 s. protocol.capture_window_rule: At/after 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z: --underlying BTC --days 3.7 --end <now-ISO> --out-dir data/raw/eval67 --seal. At end 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z this gives start 2026-11-16T07:12:00Z (disjoint from 2026-11-16T06:48:16Z; span 319680 s). If running later, start moves later and stays disjoint. Do not weaken the EVAL-64 floor.
protocol.signal: signal_z_k = expanding-zscore of per-bar options order-flow toxicity (tox) / signed-aggressor imbalance (imbalance), reused verbatim from EVAL-61/EVAL-62 (causal, end-of-bar k)
protocol.target: rv_{k+1..k+H} = sqrt(mean(log-return^2)) over the next H perp 1m/5m bars (forward realized vol, strictly after the decision at k)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(signal_z_k, rv_forward_k)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BTC and at least one of the pre-registered configs (tox::bar60::h72, imbalance::bar60::h72), Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, pooled BH-FDR rejects that config, the EVAL-64 floor is met, and the capture window is disjoint from the sealed BTC window; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS) when floor+disjoint but not predictive, or BLOCKED when floor/disjoint fails.
